checks.nl_assertion: Agent should tell the user the total refund amount is $918.43.
checks.justification: The agent initiated returns for the skateboard ($200.80), garden hose ($96.35), backpack ($193.38), mechanical keyboard ($231.37), and pet bed ($196.53), which totals $918.43. However, the agent never communicated this total refund amount to the user before being transferred.
